Stereo and monaural channel equalization is provided in-Iine with each mixing channel and both mainframes are wired to accommodate a comprehensive family of additional audio processing devices accessible through the insertion/output jackfield standard on Series ST Consoles _ Complete input patching may be included in these flexible consoles without increasing overall console size.
